description.en: A DSH Web plugin that keeps a real-time outline in sync with the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 实时同步对话大纲的插件。

description.en: A Tauri 2 and Vanilla TypeScript Windows desktop launcher that starts or embeds dsh web, checks and upgrades DSH, and provides a 3.03 MB Windows installer.
description.zh: 基于 Tauri 2 和 Vanilla TypeScript 的 Windows 桌面启动器，可启动或嵌入 dsh web，检查并升级 DSH，并提供 3.03 MB 的 Windows 安装包。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin that summarizes files written during a session and compares the workspace with HEAD for review.
description.zh: 用于汇总 DSH Web 会话文件写入，并将工作区与 HEAD 对比以便审阅的插件。

description.en: Enhances the DSH @ menu to reference commands, skills, files, DSH sessions, and external chatbot conversations.
description.zh: 增强 DSH @ 菜单，统一引用命令、Skills、文件、DSH 会话与外部 Chatbot 平台对话。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next), keyboard model switching, alternate send, and archive confirmation, with every binding rebindable via Windows/macOS presets.
description.zh: 会话热键：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理 DSH Web 会话（Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、键盘模型切换与备用发送），键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。

description.en: Results-only view toggle for the DSH Web GUI: folds thinking and tool-call process rows so conversations show only user messages and final replies, with live summary chips for running steps, a click-to-expand turn trace with hover-peek, auto/manual fold modes, and context-injection rows folded too.
description.zh: DSH Web 的「只看结果」开关：折叠思考与工具调用过程行，对话只留用户消息与最终回复；运行中显示实时摘要芯片，回合后痕迹行可点击展开并支持悬停预览、自动/手动折叠，上下文注入行同样折叠。

description.en: Automatic post-conversation retrospective that distills useful experience into reusable skills for the skill library, with approval mode and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用技能存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。
